programs.name: Engineering
programs.notes: Admission is through the Canadian Armed Forces Regular Officer Training Plan (ROTP), not a standard OUAC offer: selection includes an aptitude test, medical exam, and interview, tuition is subsidized, and graduates owe a period of obligatory military service as commissioned officers.

supplementary.name: Canadian Forces Aptitude Test (CFAT)
supplementary.description: Standardized aptitude test written at a Canadian Armed Forces recruiting centre as part of ROTP selection.

supplementary.name: CAF selection interview and medical
supplementary.description: Interview and medical examination conducted by the Canadian Armed Forces as part of ROTP selection.

tips.title: Start the ROTP file early
tips.detail: RMC selection runs through Canadian Armed Forces recruiting and includes the CFAT, a medical, and an interview on top of grades. Recruiting files take months to process, so apply in the fall rather than waiting for the deadline.

tips.title: ROTP application deadline
tips.detail: RMC applications go through Canadian Armed Forces recruiting (ROTP) rather than a standard OUAC program choice, with deadlines typically in late January. Aim to have your file complete by January 15, 2027.
